def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find a solid divider, allowing a divider to be multiple adjacent lines.
    col = next((c for c in range(w)
                if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)
    if col is not None:
        left = [row[:col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[col + 1:] for row in grid]
        common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
        color = min(common)
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(min(len(left[r]), len(right[r])))]
                for r in range(h)]

    # Remove all full-width uniform divider rows.
    divider_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    first, last = min(divider_rows), max(divider_rows)
    top = grid[:first]
    bottom = grid[last + 1:]
    common = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
    color = min(common)
    n = max(len(top), len(bottom))
    out = []
    for r in range(n):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            a = top[r][c] if r < len(top) else color
            b = bottom[r][c] if r < len(bottom) else color
            row.append(3 if a == color and b == color else color)
        out.append(row)
    return out
